articles.summary: MarineMax, Inc. (NYSE: HZO) (“MarineMax” or the “Company”), a boat and yacht retailer, marina operator, and superyacht services company, plans to release its fourth quarter and full year fiscal 2026 financial results before the opening of the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. In light of the Company's pending acquisition by Safe Harbor Marinas (“Safe Harbor”), a marina and superyacht service business, as announced on August 10, 2026, MarineMax will not hold a conference call to discuss its financial results and does not intend to provide financial guidance for fiscal 2027. The full financial results news release will be accessible from the MarineMax website, investor.marinemax.com . About MarineMax As a boat and yacht retailer, marina operator, and superyacht services company, MarineMax (NYSE: HZO) is United by Water. articles.title: MarineMax to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Financial Results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026
